description: Dated records of what companies filed and what federal agencies and the Federal Reserve published, newest first, each with its source, its date or time and a link. Name a company in `about` for its filings alone; `kind` narrows to filed or official records; `since` and `until`, or `as_of`, set the window. Every answer names the sources it read. It states records, not reasons. Needs an API key.

about.description: One company, by ticker or ISIN. Left out, records of every company and agency read.

as_of.description: Only records dated on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD; in place of until.

kind.description: filed (company filings) or official (federal agency and Federal Reserve documents). Both when left out.

limit.description: Records one call returns, 1 to 25. Default 10.

since.description: The first date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Seven days before until when left out.

until.description: The last date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Today (UTC) when left out.

name: get_news
title: Get News
